subject: Benchmark run: request for expanded trial credits to validate throughput
messages:
From: Alessandra Rossi <alessandra.rossi@dataforge.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T08:13:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood trial — can we expand credits for a multi-day benchmark?

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. We ran the small latency checks on your hosted API and are impressed with the tail latency numbers. Before we commit to a pilot, our infra team wants to run a 48-hour throughput benchmark that simulates steady 600 RPS sustained traffic with spikes to 1.2k RPS.

Can Redwood provision an additional 250k token credits and allow the trial duration to be extended by 4 days? We also need the right to run a simultaneous open-load test (no black-boxing) and will share a short results CSV.

Attached is our benchmark spec (DF_Benchmark_Specs.pdf).

Appreciate if you can confirm process and any docs you need for compliance.

Best,
Alessandra
Alessandra Rossi
Head of Platform
DataForge Inc
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alessandra Rossi <alessandra.rossi@dataforge.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood trial — can we expand credits for a multi-day benchmark?

Hi Alessandra — appreciate the spec and details.

Short answer: yes, we typically can make a one-time trial credit top-up for benchmark runs, and we can extend the trial window. I need to coordinate an internal approval for the token amount and ensure SRE is looped for guidance on safe load profiles.

Next steps from my side:
- Run the spec by our SEs and request a top-up approval from Marissa (I copied her below).
- Share a lightweight testing agreement and the allowed maintenance window (we ask that noise tests stay within the agreed spike budgets).
- Confirm that any exported logs you need are within our normal trial export limits; if not, we'll raise a temporary exception.

I'll kick this off now and get back within a few hours.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: FWD: DataForge benchmark — approval request for 250k trial tokens and 4-day extension

Marissa — forwarding request from DataForge. Summary: they want an additional 250k tokens and a 4-day window to run a 48-hour continuous throughput test (steady 600 RPS, spikes to 1.2k RPS). They've attached the DF_Benchmark_Specs.pdf.

Key risk/asks:
- We should limit peak testing windows to 2 x 30-min windows at 1.2k RPS rather than sustained spikes to protect shared infra (they're asking for continuous spikes in their spec).
- SE (Priyom) recommends we provision temporary concurrency locks and enable a higher guardrail so their test doesn't cause noisy neighbor impact.

If approved, I'd like to grant credits as a marketing/trial promotion (non-refundable) and route the trial extension through our console. We will require a short acceptance email from them acknowledging the maintenance agreement.

Can you approve the 250k token grant + 4-day extension and sign off on the maintenance constraints?

—Sean
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FWD: DataForge benchmark — approval request for 250k trial tokens and 4-day extension

Thanks for the context. I approve a one-time promotional top-up of 250,000 tokens and a four-day trial extension for DataForge (deal DF-2026-019) under these conditions:
- They acknowledge and sign the temporary test agreement (no sustained >90s spikes above 1.2k RPS without pre-notice).
- We will limit two permitted peak windows to 30 minutes each at 1.2k RPS; rest of the run must adhere to 600 RPS average.
- CS (Evelyn) to own post-run review and capture telemetry.

Priyom — please coordinate the guardrail config with SRE and prepare a short runbook for the customer.

Sean — redact the top-up in the console and attach the redwood-trial-topup-terms.docx; mark the credits as promotional/non-billable.

Marissa Cole
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T14:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FWD: DataForge benchmark — guardrails and runbook

Sean / team,

I've reviewed the DF_Benchmark_Specs.pdf. Technical notes:
- We'll create a temporary policy that enforces circuit-breaker behavior at queue depth and rate limits per-region.
- I'll provision a separate trial project with the promotional tokens and enable KV prefix caching to keep token costs down during repeats.
- Need the customer's JWT audience for any authorized log exports.

I'll prepare a 1-page runbook (to be uploaded to the Drive link) and coordinate a 30-minute pre-run sync with DataForge SREs tomorrow morning.

Attaching the benchmark-results-template.csv (stub) for their use.

—Priyom
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alessandra Rossi <alessandra.rossi@dataforge.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-22T15:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood trial — can we expand credits for a multi-day benchmark?

Hi Alessandra — good news: Marissa approved a one-time promotional top-up of 250,000 tokens and a four-day extension. Summary of agreed conditions below and attached the trial terms doc: redwood-trial-topup-terms.docx.

Agreed items:
- Credit grant: 250,000 tokens (promotional; non-billable).
- Trial extended: +4 calendar days starting 2026-09-24 00:00 UTC.
- Peak windows: two 30-minute allowed spikes up to 1.2k RPS; all other time should average ~600 RPS.
- They must sign the temporary testing agreement (reply-all with acceptance).
- Priyom will run a 30-minute pre-test sync on 2026-09-23 09:00 PT to set guardrails and exchange JWT audience for logs.

Attachments included: DF_Benchmark_Specs.pdf (from you), redwood-trial-topup-terms.docx, benchmark-results-template.csv (stub).

Please reply with a one-line acceptance so we can turn on credits and schedule the pre-run.

Best,
Sean
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-trial-topup-terms.docx (docx)]
